summary.text: Jason Ortitay is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 46 who took office on December 1, 2014, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former bank relationship manager, he founded Jason's Cheesecake Company LLC.

paragraphs.text: Ortitay graduated from Avella High School in 2002, earned a Bachelor of Business Administration from Robert Morris University in 2004 and an MBA from Stetson University in 2005.
His professional experience includes working as a relationship manager and in treasury management for PNC Bank, founding Jason's Cheesecake Company LLC, and creating the Speaker Survivor Series.

In the 2023-2024 session Ortitay was assigned to the House Education, Environmental Resources & Energy, Local Government, State Government and Transportation committees, chairing subcommittees on special education, boroughs and highways.
Democrat Mike Crossey is his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
